# Coding Agent Toolkit

> Extensions for the Pi coding agent and native mods for Herdr. Pi extensions include Slate (terminal UI), Ask (structured interviews), Automode (permission gate), Subagents (delegation), and Web Search (cited public retrieval). The Insights mod provides a local-first Herdr token-usage dashboard for Pi, Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode sessions.

Packages and mods live at the repository root, not under `packages/`. Pi extensions and Herdr mods are installed separately. All five Pi extensions are published on npm; install them individually with `pi install npm:<package>` or together with `pi install .` from a checkout. Neither method installs Herdr mods.

## Documentation

- [Root README](README.md): separate Pi extension and Herdr mod indexes, installation, development
- [Slate README](pi-slate/README.md): TUI setup, commands, themes, composer keys
- [Ask README](pi-ask/README.md): `ask_user` contract, commands, TUI-only behavior
- [Automode README](pi-automode/README.md): permission gate, commands, rules, verified launcher, classifier review
- [Subagents README](pi-subagents/README.md): delegation contract and benchmarks
- [Web Search README](pi-web-search/README.md): tools, native Parallel MCP, optional Pi-hosted Jev classifier, config, credentials, limits
- [Web Search research](pi-web-search/docs/research.md): opt-in multi_search and Jev

## Pi extensions

- [Root manifest](package.json): collection extensions, skills, and themes
- [Slate package](pi-slate/package.json): `npm:pi-slate`
- [Ask package](pi-ask/package.json): `npm:@gagansd/pi-ask`
- [Automode package](pi-automode/package.json): `npm:@gagansd/pi-automode`
- [Subagents package](pi-subagents/package.json): `npm:@gagansd/pi-subagents`
- [Web Search package](pi-web-search/package.json): `npm:@gagansd/pi-web-search`

## Herdr mods

- [Insights installation](herdr-insights/INSTALL.md): agent installation steps and completion criteria
- [Insights README](herdr-insights/README.md): installation, settings, privacy, development, uninstallation
- [Insights recipe](herdr-insights/RECIPE.md): native mod specification, architecture, rebuild requirements
- [Insights manifest](herdr-insights/package.json): local install and uninstall scripts; not published on npm
- [Insights development](docs/herdr-insights-development.md): tests and opt-in native release validation

For installation, follow herdr-insights/INSTALL.md and the user's Herdr AGENTS.md. Insights requires Herdr and Node.js 22.15+. From a checkout, run `npm run install:local --prefix herdr-insights`; it runs `herdr-app check` without opening tabs or test windows. Add `-- --open` only when requested. Layouts, keys, and terminals are unchanged. Session data stays local; no account or API key is required. RECIPE.md is the rebuild brief, not an installation test plan. Developer checks (`npm run test:insights`, `npm run check:insights`) and opt-in native smoke tests live outside the distribution; see docs/herdr-insights-development.md.
